item.title: MHP investigating alleged hit-and-run crash on MLK Road
item.description: Mississippi Highway Patrol is investigating an alleged hit and run accident on Martin Luther King Road near Old Country Club Road. Anyone with information is asked to call 911 immediately.

item.title: Most wanted: Sheriff's Office releases updated list
item.description: Adams County sheriff releases updated five most wanted list, naming suspects sought on sex offender registration, forgery, drug and other felony charges; public asked to report tips.

item.title: Prayer warriors fight for life at rally on Natchez Bluff
item.description: A small crowd gathers on Natchez Bluff for the annual Miss-Lou Right to Life Rally, blending worship and prayer while voicing concern for the unborn babies with increases in abortion access.

item.title: Driver strikes utility pole, causing Jackson Street residents on MLK to lose electricity; Road closed for repair
item.description: Crash into power pole on MLK Jr. Street knocks out power for about half a dozen Jackson Street residents and closes the road in Natchez during Saturday evening repairs.

item.title: OUT OF THIS WORLD: See unforgettable moments from the Krewe of Janus Grand Ball
item.description: Photos capture 'Out of this World' Krewe of Janus Grand Ball at Natchez Convention Center, with royalty, elaborate costumes, lively entertainment, a festive second line and dancing.

item.title: Looking back: Lost to 1970s urban renewal
item.description: A 1970s urban renewal project on St. Catherine Street razed decaying rentals—and erased historic cottages and shade trees captured in Bill Stewart’s photographs.

item.title: Body of missing person found in vacant home in Adams County
item.description: Missing Claiborne County man found dead in vacant Adams County house; body wrapped in blankets as investigators await autopsy to determine cause of death.

item.title: Natchez firefighters battle blaze at historic Dunleith Dairy Barn
item.description: Natchez firefighters are battling a blaze at Dunleith’s historic Dairy Barn after smoke was reported pouring from the structure shortly after 8 p.m.; details remain limited.

item.title: Local musicians take spotlight during the weekend Mississippi Songwriting Festival
item.description: Downtown Natchez was alive with music, thanks to the Capital-River Region Mississippi Songwriters Festival. The two-day event featured songwriters and musicians at restaurants, bars, and other venues across the city. Saturday night, local and regional musicians, including Hannah Belle, Maggie Brown, Brint Anderson, and John Mohead were featured at the Natchez Civic Center as part of the event. Here are a few images from that event.

item.title: VIDEO & GALLERY: Firefighters battle blaze inside historic Dairy Barn at Dunleith
item.description: Firefighters contain blaze at Dunleith's 1785 Dairy Barn in Natchez; smoke visible for miles, no injuries reported, cause under investigation, structure may be rebuildable.
